Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi, Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Executive Council Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan on the sidelines of
the XVIII BRICS Summit
(New Delhi, September 12, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
Your Highness, I am very glad
to see you again
.
At the outset of our meeting, I would like to note that this year – in December, I believe –
we mark 55 years since the establishment of diplomatic relations between our countries
.
Much has changed over this time, both in the world and in our relations.
The UAE has become one of our closest partners in the region
.
📈
This goes beyond the economy, where things are going well: our trade is growing
– it is already substantial and continues to grow. It also extends to political cooperation and security matters.
Of course, the region is going through
a very difficult period
, but
we remain in
regular contact
with the UAE leadership
, with your father, President of the UAE
Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
. I ask you to convey my very best wishes to him.
Our officials visit each other, meet and discuss various issues.
He and I discuss the most important and pressing matters
by telephone
. I am confident that, despite all the difficulties we face today, the situation will stabilise.
🤝
Our relations will endure and grow stronger – I have no doubt about that.
Once again, I am very glad to see you and to discuss our bilateral relations. And, of course,
it is very important for us to hear your assessment of events unfolding in the region right now
, as well as your views on how they may develop.

item.title: ⚡️ #KievRegimeCrimes Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
item.description: #KievRegimeCrimes ⚡️ Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik : PHOTO FACTS & EVIDENCE of crimes committed by Ukrainian armed forces over the week of September 7 - September 13, 2026 : ▪️ September 7 – a UAV strike on a civilian passenger car in Novaya Kakhovka, Kherson Region. ▪️ September 7 – a fixed-wing UAV strike on an apartment building in Perm, Perm Territory. One civilian was killed, four others were injured. ▪️ September 8 – a UAV strike on the Holy Dormition St Nicholas and St Basil Monastery in Nikolskoye, DPR. ▪️ September 8 – a UAV strike on a secondary school building in Orlyanskoye, Zaporozhye Region. ▪️ September 9 – a UAV strike on a market in Kakhovka, Kherson Region. ▪️ September 9 – a UAV strike on an apartment building in Novorossiysk, Krasnodar Territory. Four civilians, including a child, were killed. Another 29 were injured. ▪️ September 9 – a naval drone strike on the waterfront in Sochi, Krasnodar Territory. Twenty-eight civilians, including two children, were injured. ▪️ September 11 – a UAV strike on an ambulance in the Volnovakha District, DPR. ▪️ September 12 – a UAV strike on an apartment building in Oktyabrsky, Belgorod Region. ▪️ September 13 – an artillery strike on a grocery store in Bekhtery, Kherson Region.

item.title: 🎙 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with Prime Minister of Ethiopia Abiy Ahmed on the sidelines of
item.description: 🎙 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with Prime Minister of Ethiopia Abiy Ahmed on the sidelines of the XVIII BRICS Summit (New Delhi, September 12, 2026) 💬 Vladimir Putin: I am glad to meet with you again . I know that yesterday your country celebrated the beginning of the year 2019 according to the Ethiopian calendar, and, of course, I congratulate you and all the people of friendly Ethiopia on this occasion . We are meeting today on the sidelines of #BRICS . We have just delivered our remarks , sharing our views on our organisation. Today, BRICS is a comprehensive strategic partnership aimed at consolidating the positions of the global majority and shaping a fair #MultipolarWorld . Ethiopia has been a full member of the organisation since January 1, 2024 , and we are very pleased about this. It is symbolic that our Ethiopian friends began their practical work within BRICS mechanisms as Russia assumed the chairship. Since then, Ethiopia has made a constructive contribution to its diverse activities . 🤝 Turning to bilateral relations, I would like to emphasise once again that Ethiopia is Russia’s longstanding and reliable partner on the African continent . I am pleased to note that Russia-Ethiopia ties continue to develop on the principles of equality and mutual benefit. Mr Prime Minister, I would like to thank you for your significant personal contribution to strengthening our ties. Our bilateral trade has gained considerable momentum .

Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with Prime Minister of Ethiopia Abiy Ahmed on the sidelines of
the XVIII BRICS Summit
(New Delhi, September 12, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
I am glad
to meet with you again
.
I know that yesterday your country celebrated the beginning of the year 2019 according to the Ethiopian calendar, and, of course,
I congratulate you and all the people of friendly Ethiopia on this occasion
.
We are meeting today on the sidelines of
#BRICS
.
We have just delivered our remarks
, sharing our views on our organisation.
Today, BRICS is a comprehensive strategic partnership
aimed at consolidating the positions of the global majority and shaping a fair
#MultipolarWorld
.
Ethiopia has been
a full member of the organisation since January 1, 2024
, and we are very pleased about this. It is symbolic that our Ethiopian friends began their practical work within BRICS mechanisms as Russia assumed the chairship. Since then,
Ethiopia has made a constructive contribution to its diverse activities
.
🤝
Turning to bilateral relations, I would like to emphasise once again that Ethiopia is Russia’s longstanding and reliable partner on the African continent
. I am pleased to note that Russia-Ethiopia ties continue to develop on the principles of equality and mutual benefit. Mr Prime Minister, I would like to thank you for your significant personal contribution to strengthening our ties.
Our bilateral trade has gained considerable momentum
. In 2025, trade
more than tripled
and continues to grow. This is a good result.
We attach great importance to humanitarian cooperation
.
More than 20,000 of your citizens
have received an education in Russia, providing a very solid foundation for our future cooperation in this area.
🌍
Of course, Russia attaches particular importance to the comprehensive development of relations with African countries as a whole
. Ethiopia has played an active part in
the #RussiaAfrica Summits
. As we agreed, we look forward to welcoming you to
the Third Summit
, which will take place in Moscow on October 28-29 this year, where we will hold
another bilateral meeting
. Today, we have an opportunity to discuss the full range of our relations.

⚡️
On September 12,
the XVIII BRICS Summit
adopted
the New Delhi Declaration “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability”
.
📄
FULL TEXT
(
Russian
|
English
)
1. We, the Leaders of
#BRICS
countries,
met in New Delhi
, India, from September 12 to 13, 2026 for
the XVIII BRICS Summit
held under the theme:
“Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability”
.
2.
We reaffirm our commitment to the BRICS spirit
of mutual respect and understanding, sovereign equality, solidarity, democracy, openness, inclusiveness, collaboration and consensus.
Building on two decades of BRICS,
we further commit ourselves to strengthening cooperation in the expanded BRICS
under the three pillars of political and security, economic and financial, cultural and people-to-people cooperation, and to enhancing our strategic partnership for the benefit of our people through the promotion of peace, a more representative, fairer international order, a reinvigorated and reformed multilateral system, sustainable development and inclusive growth.
3.
We recognise the valuable contribution of Partner countries to BRICS cooperation.
We underscore our strong belief that advancing the BRICS partnership with Emerging Markets and Developing Countries (
#EMDCs
) will further contribute to strengthening the spirit of solidarity and international cooperation for the benefit of all.
We reaffirm our commitment to fostering inclusive, mutually beneficial and development-oriented partnership with Partner countries
. We encourage their increasing participation in BRICS engagements and practical cooperation in areas of shared interest.
4.
We commend India
for hosting
the Outreach/BRICS Plus Dialogue segment
of
the XVIII BRICS Summit
, which injects new impetus to strengthen international cooperation and solidarity.
7. On the landmark occasion of the
2️⃣
0️⃣
th anniversary of BRICS,
we reiterate our commitment to reforming and improving global governance
by promoting a more just, equitable, agile, effective, efficient, responsive, representative, legitimate, democratic and accountable international and multilateral system in the spirit of extensive consultation, joint contribution and shared benefits.
Bearing in mind the need to adapt the current architecture of international relations to better reflect the contemporary realities,
we reiterate our commitment to strengthening multilateralism and multipolarity and to upholding international law, including the Purposes and Principles of
the UN Charter
in their entirety and interconnectedness in a balanced and inclusive manner, as its indispensable cornerstone, and the central role of the
#UN
in the international system.
***
139.
We
commend India’s BRICS Chairship in 2026
and express our gratitude to the government and people of India for holding
the XVIII BRICS Summit
in the city of New Delhi.
140.
We extend full support to China for its BRICS Chairship in 2027
and the holding of the XIX BRICS Summit in China.
